versions.changelog:
Initial release — your guide to confident sourdough starter care:

- Maintains feeding schedules and calculates ratios for counter vs. fridge storage.
- Converts and calculates hydration percentages (stiff, liquid, or standard starter).
- Provides readiness tracking, including float test accuracy and rise timelines by temperature.
- Diagnoses common starter issues (no rise, odd smells, hooch, mold) and prescribes recovery protocols.
- Guides on hibernation/vacation management and safe revival timelines.
- Plans levain builds timed precisely for your intended bake.
- Designed for both new and ongoing sourdough starters (wheat or rye).
